moments.title: Commonwealth Games Finale
moments.blurb: The Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games wrap up on Sunday, August 2nd, after 11 days of elite competition across various sports.

angles.name: Glasgow's Big Goodbye
angles.copy: It's the final weekend of the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow! Who's taking home gold as the action wraps up on Sunday?

angles.name: Team UK Medal Haul
angles.copy: After a fantastic run, the Glasgow Commonwealth Games conclude this Sunday. How many medals will Team UK add to their tally before the closing ceremony?

moments.title: AIG Women's Open Finishes
moments.blurb: The AIG Women's Open golf championship concludes its 2026 tournament at Royal Lytham & St Annes on Sunday, August 2nd.

angles.name: Golf Grand Finale
angles.copy: Who will be crowned champion at the AIG Women's Open this Sunday? All eyes on Royal Lytham & St Annes for the final round!

angles.name: Sunday Golf Drama
angles.copy: It's Championship Sunday at the AIG Women's Open. Catch all the drama as the world's best golfers battle for the title.

moments.title: Scottish Premiership Season Starts
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Scottish Premiership season kicks off on Sunday, August 2nd, with several opening fixtures across the country.

angles.name: New Season Hopes
angles.copy: The Scottish Premiership is BACK! Who are you tipping for glory as the new season gets underway this Sunday?

angles.name: Football's Back in Scotland
angles.copy: Get ready, Scotland! The Premiership season starts this Sunday. Which match are you most looking forward to?

moments.title: European Athletics Championships
moments.blurb: Birmingham hosts the European Athletics Championships from August 10th to 16th, marking the first time the UK has held this prestigious event.

angles.name: Birmingham's Big Race
angles.copy: Get ready for track and field! The European Athletics Championships hit Birmingham from August 10th. Who are you rooting for?

angles.name: UK's First Host
angles.copy: History in the making! The UK is hosting the European Athletics Championships for the first time ever, starting August 10th in Birmingham.

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The 2026 Community Shield, featuring Manchester City vs. Arsenal, will take place on Sunday, August 16th, at Principality Stadium in Cardiff.

angles.name: Football's Curtain Raiser
angles.copy: Cardiff is hosting the Community Shield on August 16th! Man City vs. Arsenal – who's taking the first silverware of the season?

angles.name: Cardiff Gets the Shield
angles.copy: The Community Shield is coming to Wales! Manchester City take on Arsenal in Cardiff on August 16th. Big game for the Principality Stadium!

moments.title: Camp Bestival Final Days
moments.blurb: Camp Bestival, the family-friendly festival at Lulworth Castle, Dorset, wraps up its 2026 edition on Sunday, August 2nd.

angles.name: Bestival's Last Hurrah
angles.copy: It's the final weekend of Camp Bestival! Who's making the most of the last day of music, fun, and family vibes in Dorset?

angles.name: Farewell to Lulworth
angles.copy: Sad to see Camp Bestival end! If you're there for the final day, what's been your highlight of the weekend?

moments.title: Boardmasters Festival Approaches
moments.blurb: The Boardmasters Festival, combining music and surf, kicks off in Cornwall from August 7th to 9th.

angles.name: Surf & Sound Soon
angles.copy: Boardmasters is just a week away! Ready for sun, surf, and incredible music down in Cornwall? Who are you buzzing to see?

angles.name: Cornwall's Calling
angles.copy: The countdown is on for Boardmasters 2026! Who's heading to Watergate Bay & Fistral Beach for the ultimate summer festival?

moments.title: The Roots Picnic UK Debut
moments.blurb: The iconic Roots Picnic makes its highly anticipated international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl, London, on August 8th and 9th.

angles.name: London's Roots Run Deep
angles.copy: The legendary Roots Picnic lands in London next weekend! Crystal Palace Bowl is about to get a dose of world-class hip hop and culture.

angles.name: Hip Hop in Crystal Palace
angles.copy: Who's ready for The Roots Picnic? London's Crystal Palace Bowl hosts the UK debut of this massive hip hop festival on August 8th & 9th!

moments.title: Cambridge Folk Festival Begins
moments.blurb: The renowned Cambridge Folk Festival kicks off on Saturday, August 1st, bringing a weekend of traditional and contemporary folk music.

angles.name: Folk Fest Fun
angles.copy: Cambridge Folk Festival starts tomorrow! Who's heading to one of the UK's most beloved folk events this weekend?

angles.name: Weekend of Folk
angles.copy: If you're a folk fan, Cambridge is the place to be this weekend! The iconic festival begins tomorrow, August 1st.

moments.title: UK Singles Chart Buzz
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' continues its dominant run at the top of the Official UK Singles Chart, while recent albums from Madonna and Ariana Grande generate buzz.

angles.name: Chart Topper Reign
angles.copy: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is still holding strong at Number 1! Can anything knock it off the top spot this week?

angles.name: Album Drops Still Hot
angles.copy: Madonna's 'Confessions II' and Ariana Grande's 'petals' are still flying off the shelves (and streams!). Which new album are you loving most?

moments.title: James Hetfield's 63rd Birthday
moments.blurb: Metallica frontman James Hetfield celebrates his 63rd birthday on Monday, August 3rd. He was born in 1963.

angles.name: Master of Puppets Turns 63
angles.copy: Happy 63rd Birthday to the legendary James Hetfield! What's your favourite Metallica riff from the man himself?

angles.name: Metallica Icon's Big Day
angles.copy: Raise your horns! James Hetfield of Metallica turns 63 on Monday. What's the ultimate Metallica track that defines his career for you?

moments.title: Geri Halliwell's 54th Birthday
moments.blurb: Spice Girls icon Geri Halliwell (Ginger Spice) turns 54 on Thursday, August 6th. She was born in 1972.

angles.name: Spice Up Your Thursday
angles.copy: It's Ginger Spice's birthday! Geri Halliwell turns 54 on Thursday. What's your favourite Spice Girls memory?

angles.name: Happy Birthday Geri
angles.copy: Girl Power! Geri Halliwell celebrates her 54th birthday on August 6th. Which solo hit of hers still gets you dancing?

moments.title: The Edge's 65th Birthday
moments.blurb: U2 guitarist The Edge (David Evans) celebrates his 65th birthday on Saturday, August 8th. He was born in 1961.

angles.name: U2 Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Happy 65th Birthday to U2's iconic guitarist, The Edge! What's the most instantly recognisable U2 intro thanks to his unique sound?

angles.name: Edge Turns 65
angles.copy: From 'With or Without You' to 'Vertigo', The Edge turns 65 on Saturday! Celebrate the U2 legend with your favourite track!

moments.title: Scottish Summer Bank Holiday
moments.blurb: Scotland observes its Summer Bank Holiday on Monday, August 3rd, offering a long weekend for many.

angles.name: Long Weekend for Scotland
angles.copy: Happy Summer Bank Holiday to our listeners in Scotland! What are your plans for the long weekend?

angles.name: August Bank Holiday North of the Border
angles.copy: While England & Wales wait, Scotland gets its Summer Bank Holiday this Monday, August 3rd! Enjoy the extra day off!

moments.title: Exeter's Live Music Weekend
moments.blurb: Exeter is buzzing with live music this weekend, including 80s tribute band Betamax and a Rum & Reggae night at Exeter Phoenix, plus MC Devvo and Indie Club at The Cavern.

angles.name: Exeter's Weekend Soundtrack
angles.copy: Your weekend soundtrack is sorted, Exeter! From 80s throwbacks with Betamax to Rum & Reggae vibes and MC Devvo, what's your pick tonight?

angles.name: Live in Exeter Tonight
angles.copy: Friday night in Exeter means live music! Head to Exeter Phoenix for Betamax or The Cavern for MC Devvo and Indie Club. Where are you heading?

moments.title: Arctic Numpties in Exeter
moments.blurb: The UK's number one Arctic Monkeys tribute, Arctic Numpties, bring their debut album 20th anniversary show to Exeter Phoenix on Friday, August 7th.

angles.name: Exeter Goes Arctic
angles.copy: Get ready, Exeter! Arctic Numpties are bringing their acclaimed Arctic Monkeys tribute to Exeter Phoenix next Friday, August 7th. Don't miss it!

angles.name: A Certain Romance in Exeter
angles.copy: Arctic Numpties celebrate 20 years of the Arctic Monkeys' debut album at Exeter Phoenix next Friday! Who's going?
